details: Malicious package. `@raletea/baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). `lib/custom.js` defines a `customConfig` with `autoFollow: true` and four hardcoded attacker-controlled WhatsApp channels: 120363424153860594@newsletter, 120363410545373711@newsletter, 120363412937298338@newsletter, 120363408573518135@newsletter. `lib/Socket/index.js` wraps the default `makeWASocket` and, on the first successful connection, calls `autoFollowChannels`, which issues a newsletter FOLLOW for each channel, silently subscribing the victim account. The behaviour is enabled by default. The same template and channel 120363424153860594@newsletter appear in `@nakano-cjs/baileys`. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel JID or auto-follows a channel. Version 1.0.0 carries this code; the `0.0.0-stage` placeholder does not.
